sentences.text: Shri Rajeev Pandey - Pl for respondent/State.

Order 
This is first bail application filed under Section (483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita,
2023).

2. The applicant is in jail since 11.06.2024 in connection with Crime No.503 of 2024 registered at P.S. Morwa, District- Singrauli for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 366, 366-A, 376,
376(3), 342, 506, 34 & 376-D of IPC and under Section 3/4 of POCSO Act.
3.
Prosecution story in brief is that applicant as well as co-accused persons abducted minor prosecutrix and thereafter co-accused committed aggravated penetrated sexual assault on minor prosecutrix.
In aforesaid act, present applicant assisted by bolting the door from outside.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that in the instant case, after investigation, charge sheet has been filed.
Present applicant is not main accused.
It is also urged that DNA as well as medical report does not support prosecution story.
It is also urged that no injuries have been found on the NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-JBP:55411 2 MCRC-47536-2024 person of prosecutrix.
Applicant is in custody since 11.06.2024.
On above grounds, it is urged that applicant be released on bail.

sentences.text: 5. Learned Government Advocate for the respondent/State, on the other hand, has opposed the application.
6. Looking to the facts and circumstances of the case, I deem it proper to release the applicant on bail.

7. It is directed that applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.
He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 480(3) of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
8. This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
9. M.Cr.C. stands allowed and disposed of.
10. Certified copy as per rules.
